subject: Elysian POC — request for trial top-up + accelerator bundle (exec approval)
messages:
From: Amir Rahman <amir@elysian.ai>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — two-week extension + credits to finish integration

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the quick turn on the POC. We're almost across the finish line with the embeddings integration but hit a snag with our data pipeline that will take ~10 business days to stabilize.

Can Elysian get a short extension to the trial window (2 weeks) and a one-time top-up of credits so we can complete the end-to-end tests? The usage spike this week burned through the sandbox tokens — we estimate needing ~50k token-equivalent credit to finish the validation.

If possible, our procurement lead (Priya) would also like to see a small introductory discount on month 1 if we convert to Dedicated after the trial — nothing final, just an ask to help the internal review.

We're pushing for a May 31 decision; a little flexibility here makes the difference. Happy to hop on a quick call.

Thanks,
Amir
VP of ML Engineering
Elysian Labs

Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Quick ask — two-week extension + credits to finish integration (Elysian / HV-4821)

Team — forwarding Elysian's ask. Short summary:
- They burned through sandbox tokens during an embeddings validation spike. Asking for ~50k token-equivalent credit + 2-week trial extension.
- Also asking for a small introductory month-1 discount if they go Dedicated.
- Timeline: decision by May 31 (tight).

My read: strong technical engagement, high likelihood to convert (POC execs want Redwood for latency/cost control). Deal currently forecasted at $120k ARR first year (HS stage).

Proposal I suggest we request approval for:
1) One-time top-up: 50k token credit (hosted usage).
2) Trial extension: additional 14 days.
3) Introductory onboarding discount: 12% off month-1 committed invoice if they sign Dedicated within 60 days.

Rationale: keeps momentum, reasonable revenue protection (we'd need a signed 6‑month minimum for Dedicated to justify larger concessions).

Attachments included: Elysian_POC_MAL_v2.pdf (usage/pricing appendix), poe-usage-export.csv (raw usage).

Asking for quick exec ok from Ben given the timeline — if approved I'll draft a short SOW addendum and updated DocuSign.

Thanks — r

--

On Sun, May 16, 2027 at 10:02 AM Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team — forwarding Elysian's ask...

+1 to Rachel's approach. A couple of operational points:
- Recommend we cap the one-time credit to 60k token-equivalent but tiered: 50k unconditional, additional 10k released if they sign a 6-month reserved commit within 30 days. Helps protect unit economics.
- Extension of 14 days is fine.
- Intro discount: 10-12% is within our acceptable sweet spot for this stage; suggest 12% as listed but tie to a conversion milestone (DocuSign of Dedicated MSA).

Risk: if they use dedicated burst capacity across multiple regions we could see unexpected spend. Ask: Rachel, can you confirm their expected peak QPS and whether they'll need embeddings on Dedicated or hosted for initial production? I'll flag infra if embeddings look like a Dedicated-only need.

If Ben signs off on the conditional structure I'll greenlight drafting the addendum.

Jonas
Senior Sales Manager

Ben — quick ask for your exec approval.

Recommended concession (conditional):
- 50k token credit up-front (hosted).
- 14-day trial extension.
- 12% onboarding discount on month-1 if sign Dedicated within 60 days.
- Additional 10k token credit released if a 6-month reserve is signed within 30 days.

Commercial impact: expected ARR conversion remains ~$120k; incremental cost for credits estimated ~$1.6k. We consider this a high-propensity account with low churn risk.

Required: Ben, please confirm yes/no or counter by EOD tomorrow (18 May). If approved, Rachel will issue an addendum and DocuSign link. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/345234/HV-4821

Marissa

2) Trial extension: approve 14 days.
3) Onboarding discount: approve 12% for month-1, but require signature of Dedicated MSA or 3-month minimum conversion commitment within 45 days.
